task_description: Add a REAL React (Vite) frontend to the coffee-ship demo, baked into and served by the existing stdlib-Python ECS/Fargate container (Option A). Keep the CloudFront -> ALB -> ECS architecture and the real CI/CD pipeline exactly as-is: do not break CloudFront, the ALB-SG CloudFront prefix-list lock, the imported-from-exports VPC, ECR keep-10, or the EcsDeployAction stages. Container name stays 'web'; ALB health check 'GET /' must still return 200. Multi-stage Dockerfile builds the SPA (node) and serves it from python:3.12-slim at /app/static. SPA source lives under container/frontend/ and the diagram at container/architecture.svg so the docker build context (container/) has everything. Verify by local build + cdk synth only; NO live AWS deploy. Region stays ap-southeast-1. Do NOT touch app/** or (preferably) infra/**.
